systems.system: Education Statistics Summary Report 2025 and the 2025 statistical yearbook it summarises
systems.owner: MoBSE Directorate of Planning, Policy Analysis, Research & Budgeting (EMIS unit); produced with World Bank RISE project financing
systems.tiers: national, by region, level and management type; data supplied by school heads

note: A yearly statistical summary of counts per school level (4,039 institutions, 1,444 lower basic schools, 830,895 learners in 2025); it describes no entry by schools during the year and no per-learner record, so it is census and gives no fact. It reports enabling conditions only: 10.5% of lower basic schools with internet for teaching and 57.1% with electricity in 2025.
